tool_args.rationale: The acquired wide-s_grad rows resolve the pilot collinearity and reveal strong gradient modulation. Fit the authorized two-layer siphon base with its open square-root branch, estimating vmax, rho, and the signed local branch coefficient over the full supplied fallback bounds.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Seven observations span both low and high s_grad and multiple u_now values, providing leverage to fit the three-parameter open-branch law without another paid probe.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the D09 Haldane snapshot model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-u response remains increasing and the wide s_grad probe causes large systematic variation, inconsistent with a u_now-only substrate-inhibition curve.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the D24 Cobb-Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It omits the explicitly supported saturating base field and local square-root branch; the observed monotone-concave u response and gradient-dependent contrast favor the shared siphon subtree.
